params.name: category
params.description: Only return tests with this category

params.name: exploratory_run_id
params.description: Only return created in this exploratory run

params.name: priority
params.description: Only return tests with this priority

params.name: query
params.description: Only return tests whose title contains, or ID matches, this string

params.name: result
params.description: Only return tests with a specific result

params.name: run_group_id
params.description: Only return tests in this run group; use `-1` to filter for tests not in any run groups

params.name: smart_folder_id
params.description: Only return tests in this saved filter

params.name: step_query
params.description: Only return tests whose steps match this string

params.name: tests
params.description: Only return tests matching this criteria. Can be comma-separated list of test ids or 'all' to return all tests

params.name: type
params.description: Only return tests of this type

params.name: variable
params.description: Only return tests that contain given variable

params.name: environment_id
params.description: Only return that were run in the specified environment

params.name: has_comments
params.description: Only return tests with or without comments

params.name: latest_only
params.description: Only the latest results for a test

params.name: release
params.description: Only return tests that were run in the specified release

params.name: page
params.description: Page of results to display

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results to return per page; maximum: 100

params.name: feature_id[]
params.description: Only return tests with this/these feature(s); use `-1` to filter for tests without a feature

params.name: site_id[]
params.description: Only return tests for this/these site(s)

params.name: state[]
params.description: Only return tests that with this state

params.name: tags[]
params.description: Only return tests having all specified tags; use `-1` to filter for untagged tests

params.name: run_id[]
params.description: Only return tests that were in this/these previous run(s)
